newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS MAY TURNOVER DOWN 3.2 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS MAY TURNOVER DOWN 3.2 PERCENT.

text.p: Ventspils, the leading Latvian harbour, saw its turnover on May fall 3.2 percent to 3.15 million tonnes against 3.26 million tonnes handled in April, the Diena newspaper reported on Friday.
Ventspils processed 2.5 percent less cargo than in May 1996, when 3.23 million tonnes passed through the port.

Ventspils is by far the most active Latvian transit port with 73 percent of cargo handled in the country in May. The capital Riga followed in May with 21 percent or 907,000 thousand tonnes in turnover, Diena said.
Riga saw a rise in activity of 8.3 percent in May against 838,000 tonnes in April.
Liepaja harbour had turnover of 204,800 tonnes in May, an increase of 8 percent on a month-on-month basis.
